title: Hold a pet shop approval to sell dogs
what: Conduct a pet shop business that sells dogs (a relevant pet shop business) only with a pet shop approval from the local government.

sources.title: Dog Act 1976 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a relevant pet shop business unless the person holds a pet shop approval for the pet shop granted by the local government in whose district the pet shop is located
